evals.prompt: Analyze the supplied review packet, produce a single report then propose a squash-ready PR title and body, and ask once to refine. Use the ticket link and diff as given. Do not invent a platform or extra issue number.
evals.expected_output: A single analysis report with total churn, user-facing why, semantic chunks with files, plus a proposed conventional title and squash body with Related ticket, and one refine question.
assertions: The response reports the total added and deleted lines from the packet
The response explains the user-facing problem before discussing mechanics
The response names the files covered by each semantic chunk
The response includes the verbatim ticket link under Related when provided
The response asks once to approve or revise before finishing
The response does not invent a platform, issue number, or extra link

evals.prompt: Use the supplied review packet to produce your report and proposed description. Surface the known risk and the deliberate omission as risks and follow-ups, then pause once for refinement.
evals.expected_output: A report and proposed description that identifies the known risk and deferred work, then waits once for refinement.
assertions: The response identifies the risk stated in the packet
The response identifies the deliberately deferred work stated in the packet
The response distinguishes user-provided facts from inferred decisions
The response covers a bounded semantic chunk rather than listing files alphabetically
The response pauses once for conversational refinement

evals.prompt: Review the supplied final diff and packet, then show a proposed conventional title and compact squash-ready description only after checking that each claim is grounded. Include the Related ticket verbatim when given. If anything is missing, identify it instead of guessing.
evals.expected_output: A compact traceable conventional PR title and squash body with Related ticket, with unsupported claims called out rather than invented.
assertions: The proposed title follows conventional commits
The description covers why, what changed, and risks or follow-ups
The description includes the verbatim ticket link when provided
Every material claim is traceable to the supplied context or diff
The description remains under 15 lines
Unsupported platform details and issue identifiers are not invented

evals.prompt: Analyze the larger packet with multiple files and a migration, produce a single report then propose a squash-ready PR body that scales beyond 15 lines. Include the ticket verbatim and surface rollout and migration risk, then ask once to refine.
evals.expected_output: A scaled squash body that still covers why, what changed, decisions, and risks, with total churn and semantic chunks with files, and one refine question.
assertions: The response reports the total added and deleted lines from the packet
The response names the files covered by each semantic chunk
The response includes the verbatim ticket link under Related when provided
The proposed title follows conventional commits
The description remains under 50 lines
The response does not invent a platform, issue number, or extra link
